title: 10 Neighborhoods, One Reason Each
description: Ten Luanda localities, each pinned to one concrete institution, public space, or piece of civic infrastructure.

cards.title: Ilha de Luanda
cards.subtitle: Angola’s public marine-research institute is based here.
cards.notes: The institute lists Avenida Mortala Mohamed, Ilha de Luanda, as its address.
cards.short_summary: Look to the Ilha for the headquarters of the National Institute for Fisheries and Marine Research.
cards.source_title: Instituto Nacional de Investigação Pesqueira e Marinha — Home and Contact

cards.title: Bairro Operário
cards.subtitle: Rua Garcia Neto links two of the area’s principal avenues.
cards.notes: The provincial government identifies the endpoints as Avenida Luenji A’Nkonde and Avenida Cónego Manuel das Neves.
cards.short_summary: Rua Garcia Neto provides a useful cross-neighborhood connection between two named avenues.
cards.source_title: Reabertura da Rua Garcia Neto no Histórico Bairro Operário

cards.title: Maculusso
cards.subtitle: It contains the 42-classroom Njinga Mbande secondary school.
cards.notes: Angola’s vice-presidential office places Escola N.º 1224 — Njinga Mbande in Maculusso.
cards.short_summary: Njinga Mbande gives Maculusso a large, clearly documented public-school landmark.
cards.source_title: Vice-Presidente da República Visita Escolas no Município de Luanda

cards.title: Praia do Bispo
cards.subtitle: The Guiché Único da Empresa has its headquarters here.
cards.notes: The agency lists its headquarters in the DNIRN building on Avenida Dr. Agostinho Neto, Nova Marginal, Praia do Bispo.
cards.short_summary: Praia do Bispo is the documented headquarters location for Angola’s one-stop business service.
cards.source_title: Guiché Único da Empresa — Postos de Atendimento

cards.title: Morro Bento
cards.subtitle: It has a Guiché Único da Empresa service post.
cards.notes: The agency identifies the Nosso Centro post on Avenida 21 de Janeiro in Bairro Morro Bento.
cards.short_summary: Morro Bento offers a documented branch of Angola’s one-stop business service.
cards.source_title: Guiché Único da Empresa — Postos de Atendimento

cards.title: Bairro Popular
cards.subtitle: Twenty named streets were grouped into one public-works package.
cards.notes: The provincial government’s 2020 notice lists 20 streets in Neves Bendinha’s Bairro Popular for improvements.
cards.short_summary: A single official works notice maps an unusually detailed set of 20 named Bairro Popular streets.
cards.source_title: 29 Ruas Serão Melhoradas no Âmbito do PIIM em Luanda

cards.title: Cassequel
cards.subtitle: Its numbered Ruas 1 through 9 formed one roadworks cluster.
cards.notes: The provincial government’s 2020 notice explicitly groups streets 1–9 in Bairro Cassequel.
cards.short_summary: Cassequel’s numbered street sequence is clearly recorded in a provincial infrastructure notice.
cards.source_title: 29 Ruas Serão Melhoradas no Âmbito do PIIM em Luanda

cards.title: Kinaxixi
cards.subtitle: Its restored public square includes free Wi-Fi.
cards.notes: An Angolan foreign-ministry portal reported free internet service among the square’s public facilities.
cards.short_summary: Kinaxixi’s central square is a documented public Wi-Fi point.

cards.title: Talatona
cards.subtitle: The Centro de Convenções de Talatona hosts national-sector conferences.
cards.notes: Angola’s mining regulator identifies the center as the venue for the 2025 International Mining Conference.
cards.short_summary: The convention center makes Talatona a recurring address for documented national conferences.
cards.source_title: Agência Nacional de Recursos Minerais — Eventos

cards.title: Centralidade do Kilamba
cards.subtitle: Liceu 14 de Abril has a classroom built for hybrid teaching.
cards.notes: An official Angolan diplomatic portal reports that the room supports online and in-person instruction through teleclasses and conferencing.
cards.short_summary: Kilamba’s Liceu 14 de Abril contains a documented hybrid-learning classroom.
cards.source_title: Ana Dias Lourenço Inaugura Sala Inteligente na Escola Liceu 14 de Abril no Kilamba
